heading.text: Engine Rebuilding for BMW, Mercedes, Jaguar, Land Rover

intro: Choose your brand to explore the relevant models, engine families and repair routes. A model name helps organise the enquiry; the actual engine and damage determine the work. Our main coverage is combustion-engine generations still produced in 2015 or later, including some launched earlier.

brands.name: BMW
brands.title: BMW Engine Rebuilds & Repairs
brands.text: Coverage includes 1 Series to 8 Series, X models, Z Series and relevant M cars.
brands.fullText: Coverage includes 1 Series to 8 Series, X models, Z Series and relevant M cars. N47/B47 diesels, modular petrol engines and performance units need their own identification. A 320d, M340i and M3 are different engine enquiries, not interchangeable rebuild packages.

brands.name: Mercedes-Benz
brands.title: Mercedes-Benz Engine Rebuilding
brands.text: A-Class, C-Class, E-Class, SUVs, AMG, roadster and relevant van enquiries.
brands.fullText: A-Class, C-Class, E-Class, SUVs, AMG, roadster and relevant van enquiries span several engine generations. OM651 and OM654 diesels, petrol M-series and AMG units are assessed by the fitted specification, not the badge alone.

brands.name: Jaguar
brands.title: Jaguar Engine Rebuild Specialists
brands.text: XE, XF, XJ, F-Type, F-Pace and E-Pace coverage includes relevant diesel and petrol.
brands.fullText: XE, XF, XJ, F-Type, F-Pace and E-Pace coverage includes the relevant diesel, petrol V6/V8 and Ingenium routes. Identify the model and engine before applying a guide; similar capacities can have different installations and repair scopes.

brands.name: Land Rover
brands.title: Land Rover & Range Rover Engine Rebuilds
brands.text: Defender, Discovery, Range Rover, Range Rover Sport, Evoque and Velar.
brands.fullText: Defender, Discovery, Discovery Sport, Range Rover, Range Rover Sport, Evoque and Velar have different engines across generations. V6 diesel, Ingenium, petrol V6/V8 and later-engine enquiries are individually identified before a rebuild is quoted.

image.alt: Land Rover and Range Rover engine rebuilds

brands.name: Audi
brands.title: Audi TFSI, TDI, S & RS Engine Repairs
brands.text: Covers A, Q, TT, S/RS and rare-engine enquiries across petrol and diesel units.
brands.fullText: Our Audi directory covers the relevant A, Q, TT, S/RS and rare-engine enquiries. Standard and high-output petrol, four-cylinder/V6 diesel and performance engines have separate routes; a TFSI or TDI badge is not a complete engine specification.

image.alt: Audi TFSI, TDI, S and RS engine repairs

brands.name: Volkswagen
brands.title: Volkswagen TSI, TDI & Van Engine Rebuilds
brands.text: Golf, Polo, Passat, Tiguan, Touareg and van models including Transporter and Caddy.
brands.fullText: Golf, Polo, Passat, Tiguan, Touareg and the other listed passenger models sit alongside Transporter, Caravelle, Multivan, Amarok and Caddy enquiries. Petrol output classes, passenger-car diesels and van BiTDI work are kept distinct.

image.alt: Volkswagen TSI, TDI and van engine rebuilds

brands.name: MINI
brands.title: MINI Cooper, Cooper S & JCW Engine Rebuilds
brands.text: Hatch, Convertible, Clubman, Countryman, Coupe, Roadster, Paceman and JCW routes.
brands.fullText: Hatch, Convertible, Clubman, Countryman, Coupe, Roadster, Paceman and JCW routes span different petrol/diesel families. A Cooper badge does not identify the engine; chassis, generation and actual code matter before parts or prices are selected.

image.alt: MINI Cooper, Cooper S and JCW engine rebuilds

brands.name: Porsche
brands.title: Porsche Engine Repair & Rebuilding
brands.text: 911, Boxster, Cayman, Cayenne, Panamera and combustion-engine Macan enquiries.
brands.fullText: 911, Boxster, Cayman, Cayenne, Panamera and combustion-engine Macan enquiries include flat-four, flat-six, V6 and V8 routes. Generation and derivative must be established. Specialist Turbo/GT and unusual installations are assessed individually.

brands.name: Ford
brands.title: Ford EcoBoost, EcoBlue & TDCi Engine Repairs
brands.text: Mustang, Focus ST/RS, Ranger, Transit, Transit Custom, Edge and Explorer.
brands.fullText: Selected Mustang, Focus ST/RS, Ranger, Transit, Transit Custom, Edge and combustion/hybrid Explorer enquiries are included. These names span different petrol and diesel engines; a familiar family name does not define the whole repair.
